Name: Quick Warp
Author: 258112zjy
Description:
Quick Warp
Warp anywhere, from one menu. Presets, your own points, every map, every villager.
[heading]Description[/heading]
Four tabs, one hotkey. Preset locations, spots you saved yourself, every map the game has loaded including modded ones, and any villager you have met.
Press [b]J[/b] and pick a destination. The menu stays out of the way of the game otherwise: no HUD element, no automatic warping, nothing happens until you click something.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the
[code]QuickWarp[/code]folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended.[/b] It is optional, but with it you can rebind the keys and switch the interface language from the title screen instead of editing
[code]config.json[/code]by hand.
[heading]Language[/heading]
English by default, with a full Chinese translation. Set
[code]Language[/code]to
[code]auto[/code],
[code]en[/code]or
[code]zh[/code]- in Generic Mod Config Menu, or in
[code]config.json[/code].
[code]auto[/code]follows the game's own language; the other two force it.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Presets[/b] - farm, farmhouse bed, bus stop, town, the beach outside Willy's shop, mountain, mines, desert, skull cavern, forest, secret woods, railroad, Ginger Island[/*]
[*][b]My points[/b] - spots you saved yourself. Each row shows the map and the tile, with a small [b]x[/b] to delete it. Stored per save file, so a new farm starts empty[/*]
[*][b]All maps[/b] - every location the game has loaded, including maps added by other mods. Searchable by display name or internal name[/*]
[*][b]Villagers[/b] - everyone you have met, with their current location. Click to land next to them[/*]
[/list][heading]Keys[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]J[/b] - open / close the menu[/*]
[*][b]K[/b] - save the tile you are standing on[/*]
[/list]Both can be rebound in
[code]config.json[/code].
[heading]How the arrival tile is picked[/heading]
Presets use fixed tiles that are known to be walkable.
For the "all maps" tab the mod spirals out from the middle of the map and takes the first tile that is on the map, open, empty and not a door or a trigger. That is what makes modded maps work without a hand-written coordinate table for every one of them - a map added by another mod is usable the moment it loads, with no patch needed for this mod.
[heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]The warp only moves your own farmer. Nothing is sent to other players and no host permission is needed[/*]
[*]No Harmony patches, no edits to the save file[/*]
[*]Saved points live in
[code]config.json[/code]keyed by save folder, so two farms never share a list[/*]
[*]Works next to other warp mods as long as the hotkeys differ[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Recommended: Generic Mod Config Menu - rebind keys and switch language in game[/*]
[/list][heading]Part of a set[/heading]
This is the lightweight warp-only version. [b]Cheat Panel[/b] bundles warping together with items, friendship, time and the calendar in one panel; [b]Time & Weather[/b] and [b]Set Date[/b] are the other two standalone ones. All four ship with different hotkeys, so you can install any of them side by side.
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for SMAPI[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley modding wiki, for the map and tile internals this relies on[/*]
[/list]Requests for more preset spots are welcome - tell me the map and the tile.
[line]
[heading]中文说明[/heading]
按 [b]J[/b] 随时传送。四个标签页：预设地点、自己保存的路径点、游戏里所有已加载的地图（含别的 mod 加的）、以及见过面的所有村民。
[list]
[*]安装：装好 SMAPI 4.0+，把
[code]QuickWarp[/code]文件夹解压到
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]，用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[*]界面语言：默认跟随游戏语言，也可以在 GMCM 里把「语言」设成中文或 English，不用改文件。[/*]
[*]热键：[b]J[/b] 开关菜单，[b]K[/b] 保存当前脚下的位置。[/*]

[code]config.json[/code]里，不会改存档文件。[/*]
[/list]
